title: Renewals Desk Schedule: Customer Tenure Multiplier for Residential Electricity Supply Loyalty Credits
content:
Renewals desk schedule, Residential Electricity Supply. Long-standing customers receive a larger renewal loyalty credit.

**Rule.** The loyalty credit amount, as already scaled for the length of the renewed term, is then multiplied by the long loyalty-tenure factor of 1.25 when the agreement's service start date is 36 or more whole months before the posting date, by the mid loyalty-tenure factor of 1.1 when it is 18 to 35 whole months before, and is taken as it stands when it is fewer than 18 whole months before.

| Whole months from service start date to posting date | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| 36 or more | 1.25 |
| 18 to 35 | 1.1 |
| fewer than 18 | none, taken as it stands |

**Counting.** The service start date is the switch meter read date on which Beacon Ridge supply began on the agreement; renewals do not reset it. A month is whole once the same day of the month is reached.

**Boundaries (hypothetical service start 2023-06-12).** Posting on 2026-06-12 is 36 whole months, 1.25; on 2026-06-11 it is 35 whole months, 1.1. Posting on 2024-12-12 is 18 whole months, 1.1; on 2024-12-11 it is 17 whole months, taken as it stands.

**Example (hypothetical).** An amount of 55.00 USD reached after renewed-term scaling, on an agreement 40 whole months in supply, becomes 68.75 USD.
